copied: // 文件标题放在比例区域外。

<Attachment state="done">
  <AttachmentMedia><FileIcon /></AttachmentMedia>
  <AttachmentContent><AttachmentTitle>课程导读.pdf</AttachmentTitle><AttachmentDescription>PDF · 1.8 MB</AttachmentDescription></AttachmentContent>
  <AttachmentTrigger aria-label="预览课程导读.pdf" onClick={openPreview} />
  <AttachmentActions><AttachmentAction aria-label="移除课程导读.pdf" onClick={remove}>移除</AttachmentAction></AttachmentActions>
</Attachment>

<Drawer open={open} onOpenChange={(next, details) => {
  if (!next && hasUnsavedChanges) { details.cancel(); showExitChoice(); return; }
  setOpen(next);
}} showSwipeHandle snapPoints={[0.5, 0.85]} snapPoint={snap} onSnapPointChange={setSnap}>
  <DrawerTrigger render={<Button>编辑课前任务</Button>} />
  <DrawerContent><DrawerHeader><DrawerTitle>课前任务</DrawerTitle></DrawerHeader>
    {/* 宿主正文独立滚动；Footer留在可见位置。 */}
    <DrawerFooter><DrawerClose render={<Button>关闭</Button>} /></DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>

<FormItem label="课堂验证码" status={error ? "error" : "default"} message={error}>
  <InputOTP name="classroomCode" maxLength={6} value={code} onChange={setCode}
    pattern={"^\\d+$"} onComplete={() => setLengthComplete(true)}>
    <InputOTPGroup>{[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(index => <InputOTPSlot key={index} index={index} />)}</InputOTPGroup>
  </InputOTP>
</FormItem>
// form onSubmit读取FormData，显式验证；onComplete不自动提交。

<Carousel aria-label="课程学习资料" tabIndex={0} opts={{ align: "start" }} setApi={setApi}>
  <CarouselContent>{materials.map(material =>
    <CarouselItem key={material.id} aria-label={material.title}>{/* 资料内容 */}</CarouselItem>
  )}</CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious /><CarouselNext />
</Carousel>
// Content的className设置inner布局；宿主留出外置导航空间。
// setApi订阅select/reInit，并对称off；不另造selectedIndex状态机。

const items=[{name:"goal",required:true,choices:[{value:"review"}]},{name:"note"}];
<Questionnaire items={items} onSubmit={e=>{e.preventDefault(); save(new FormData(e.currentTarget));}}>
 <QuestionnaireProgress /><QuestionnaireItem name="goal" required><QuestionnaireTitle>学习目标</QuestionnaireTitle><QuestionnaireChoice value="review">复习</QuestionnaireChoice><QuestionnaireError /></QuestionnaireItem>
 <QuestionnaireItem name="note"><QuestionnaireTitle>补充</QuestionnaireTitle><QuestionnaireInput aria-label="补充说明" /></QuestionnaireItem>
 <QuestionnaireActions><QuestionnairePrevious /><QuestionnaireSkip /><QuestionnaireNext /><QuestionnaireSubmit /></QuestionnaireActions>
</Questionnaire>
